rows.en: Ai: "Touya! You took long enough!"
Touya: "Steinies showed up over there."
Ai: "What?! Steinies, that psycho?!"
Touya: "Yeah. Fain and the others are holding him off.
We've got to finish things here quickly and..."
Cain: "Finish things quickly, hmm...
You really do underestimate me."
Touya: "Hah! I'm not good-natured enough to show respect
to some bastard who skulks around behind the scenes!"
Cain: "Are you talking about Tix?"
Touya: "And that bastard Oswald!
I hear you used him."
Cain: "Oswald? Oh, so he survived...
Yes, I was the one who used him.
To fulfill my obligation to Bernst."
Touya: "Bernst?!"
Cain: "Oh? You know him?
Then do you also know he's a member
of ≪Ze=Ode≫? Well, it doesn't matter.
Anyway, I tried to obtain the Queen's crystal
for their purposes.
But that man failed."
Ai: "You... Alforina...
Hehehehe..."
Touya: "A-Ai?!"
Ai: "Who do you think you are? I don't know why you're
so smug, but what you're doing is worse than politicians
who cling to money and power without dirtying their own hands.
They at least have principles to hide behind, even if they're lies.
You don't even have that.
You're just a brat who does whatever he wants!"
Cain: "Oh... That's right. You and Alforina
were close. I understand your anger.
I've felt something much like it myself.
Hehehe. Go ahead. Hate me.
If it will ease your heart.
That's what I'm acting for myself, after all..."
Ai: "Yes, I won't forgive you. But this isn't revenge.
It's to make sure nobody else has to go through what I did."
Cain: "Hmph... Dress it up however you like. It comes to the same thing.
People aren't wise enough to separate their feelings
so easily.
Well then, I don't have all day.
This time, I'll get serious..."
Touya: "I don't know what you're plotting,
but I can't leave you running loose any longer!
We'll settle this here!"
Cain: "Unlike you, I'm a busy person.
I don't have much time to waste on you.
So... I'm going all out!"
Ai: "Touya. I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll act alone. You handle things on your end."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I'm not ready to put my life in your hands.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I don't intend to follow your orders.
I'll act on my own."
Celica: "I'm sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice does not yet
dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
And so I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Gen: "I'll show you how much I've grown!
So I'll be acting on my own. See you!"
Melvi: "Touya, I've got an idea.
So I'm going to act on my own."
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Kururu: "I'm going to fight my own way."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow your orders properly,
Touya. So I'll do things my own way this time."
Cain: "Heh... Well, my preparations are finished, so for today
I'll withdraw in honor of your courageous actions...
Oh, right. I'd better erase the evidence..."
Touya: "Tch... He got away..."
Yamato: "What do we do, Touya?
At this rate, Oswald will..."
Touya: "We've got no choice but to go back...
I'm not letting that girl be killed because of us!"
Yamato: "Do you have a plan, meow?!"
Touya: "...No."
Yamato: "Oh, dear..."
Touya: "We're going back to the village!"
Touya: "All right, let's head back to Liebhofen for now!"

review_batches.context: Read all 83 rows and adjacent rescue/hostage members. Cain admits using Oswald for Bernst/the Queen's crystal; Ai rebukes him and rejects revenge. Separate conditional refusal branches, withdrawal and decision to return.
review_batches.decisions: Cain confirms using Oswald, not every detail of Oswald's disputed Evil Eye account. Do not identify the unnamed crystal more specifically than source. Preserve Ai's harsh political comparison, hatred-versus-prevention disagreement and unfinished angry reference to Alforina. No invented target for evidence erasure. Separate route responses and return destinations stay separate.
